verdict.rationale: The CLI docs mention an 'auto-approve all actions (use with caution)' setting, implying a default confirmation/approval step exists before actions run, and a custom 'planning agent' example is documented, but there is no explicit description of a dedicated implementation-plan review/approval step before code changes are made. missing for 10: explicit plan-presentation UI, documented approve/reject workflow for a generated plan, and confirmation that code changes are gated behind plan approval.
